data.name: Mahtaj
data.gender_notes: Mahtaj is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who provides support and assistance. Derived from the Arabic root ‘hataja’, which means to support, aid, and assist. The name Mahtaj carries the meaning “Support, Aid, Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahtaj usually hope their child will grow to embody support, aid, assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the qualities of compassion, care, and empathy in Islam.
data.etymology: Mahtaj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Aid, Assistance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahtaj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: محتاج
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَحْتَاجٌ (maḥtāju) – a person who is in need, requiring, necessitous; a person who is in a state of need, desiring, demanding, or craving something, whether it be for sustenance, knowledge, or help.

in_urdu.name: محتاج
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُحْتَاجٌ (muḥtāju) – جہاں اور زمانہ بهترین میں شراعت یا معنی کے لیے کوئی چیز کے لیے ضروری ہونا – مُحْتَاجات (muḥtājāt) – میرے ساتھ یا میرے بندور سے کوئی چیز کے لیے میرے حاجت ہوندی ہوں, میرے حاجتوں کو پانے ہوں, میرے حاجتوں کو استناد ہوں

in_hindi.name: महतज

in_pashto.name: محتاج
